question: Ethanoic acid is also known as glacial acetic acid as it:
solution:
The correct answer is **__freezes in a cold climate.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The melting point of pure ethanoic acid is 290 K and hence it often freezes during winter in cold climates.**
 
• Ethanoic acid is commonly called acetic acid and belongs to a group of acids called carboxylic acids.
